new_entities.name: Projecting visors and rims of headlights

obligations.subject: e5
obligations.response: shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision
obligations.ears: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.

obligations.subject: e5
obligations.response: shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists
obligations.ears: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.

obligations.subject: e5
obligations.response: No protruding part of the external surface shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm
obligations.ears: No protruding part of the external surface shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.

obligations.subject: e5
obligations.response: the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted
obligations.exception: save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm
obligations.ears: When parts of the external surface protrude less than 5 mm, the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.

obligations.subject: e5
obligations.response: may have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm
obligations.ears: When protruding parts of the external surface are made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 shore A, the protruding parts may have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.

obligations.subject: e5
obligations.response: The hardness measurement shall be taken with the component as installed on the vehicle
obligations.ears: The hardness measurement shall be taken with the component as installed on the vehicle.

obligations.subject: e5
obligations.response: comparable measurements shall be used for evaluation
obligations.ears: When it is impossible to carry out a hardness measurement by the Shore A procedure, comparable measurements shall be used for evaluation.

obligations.response: shall apply in addition to the particular specifications of the following paragraph 6.
obligations.exception: except where these particular specifications expressly provide otherwise
obligations.ears: The provisions of the above paragraphs 5.1. to 5.5. shall apply in addition to the particular specifications of the following paragraph 6., except where these particular specifications expressly provide otherwise.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall retract, become detached or bend over under a force of 10 daN exerted at their most salient point in any direction in a plane approximately parallel to the surface on which they are mounted
obligations.ears: When added ornaments project more than 10 mm from their support, the added ornaments shall retract, become detached or bend over under a force of 10 daN exerted at their most salient point in any direction in a plane approximately parallel to the surface on which they are mounted.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: only the general requirements of paragraph 5. shall apply
obligations.exception: These provisions shall not apply to ornaments on radiator grilles
obligations.ears: When ornaments are on radiator grilles, only the general requirements of paragraph 5. shall apply to the ornaments.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: a flat-ended ram of not more than 50 mm diameter shall be used
obligations.ears: To apply the 10 daN force a flat-ended ram of not more than 50 mm diameter shall be used.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: an equivalent method shall be used
obligations.ears: When applying the force with a flat-ended ram is not possible, an equivalent method shall be used.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: the remaining projections shall not project more than 10 mm
obligations.ears: After the ornaments are retracted, detached or bent over, the remaining projections shall not project more than 10 mm.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall in any case satisfy the provisions of paragraph 5.2.
obligations.ears: After the ornaments are retracted, detached or bent over, the remaining projections shall in any case satisfy the provisions of paragraph 5.2.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: they shall be firmly secured to the vehicle
obligations.exception: Protective strips or shielding on the external surface shall not be subject to the requirements of paragraph 6.1.1. above
obligations.ears: The protective strips or shielding on the external surface shall be firmly secured to the vehicle.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: their projection, as measured in relation to the external transparent surface of the headlight does not exceed 30 mm and their radius of curvature is at least 2.5 mm throughout
obligations.ears: When projecting visors and rims are fitted on headlights, their projection, as measured in relation to the external transparent surface of the headlight, shall not exceed 30 mm and their radius of curvature shall be at least 2.5 mm throughout.

derived.text: When projecting visors and rims are fitted on headlights, their projection, as measured in relation to the external transparent surface of the headlight, shall not exceed 30 mm.
When projecting visors and rims are fitted on headlights, their radius of curvature shall be at least 2.5 mm throughout.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: the projection shall be measured from the outermost transparent surface
obligations.ears: When a headlamp is mounted behind an additional transparent surface, the projection shall be measured from the outermost transparent surface.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 3. of Annex 3 to this Regulation
obligations.ears: The projections shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 3. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: shall meet the provisions of paragraph 6.2.1. above in both the operative and retracted positions
obligations.ears: Retracting headlights shall meet the provisions of paragraph 6.2.1. above in both the operative and retracted positions.
